items.title: Chester Zardis Interview, 1966-03-09
items.q: I used to go to his house... I'd mostly go up there and just past the time away when we wouldn't be working you know because I had my accord in and we'd just go out there and get a couple of bottles of beer

ctx.x: Do you know anything about him, where he came from or what part of town or who he played with? Who else? I know he played with Buddy for Tebitt. I wonder who else.

No I don't know who else George played with. I think George worked a while with Louis Dumaine. Oh yeah. You remember Louis Dumaine? Yeah I'm sure I knew him fairly well. Yeah. Well he worked with Louis Dumaine. And there's another trumpet player a little bit,
Raleigh. Oh let's see. Amos Raleigh. He worked with Amos a long time. You remember Amos Raleigh? Yeah. I didn't know him but his son is still playing.
